Done. `price_cart` in cart/pricing.py:6 implements the README rules:

- **Validation** — `ValueError` for `qty < 1`, negative unit price, malformed coupons, and percentages outside 1..100 (cart/pricing.py:21-25, 36-39).
- **Bulk discount** — 10% off each line with `qty >= 10`, rounded half-up per line via integer math `(amount * percent + 50) // 100` (cart/pricing.py:11-12, 27-28).
- **Coupon** — matched with `fullmatch` against `PERCENT:<digits>` / `FIXED:<digits>` (ASCII digits only, uppercase prefix), applied to the amount left after bulk discounts; fixed amounts are capped so the total never goes below zero (cart/pricing.py:32-43).

All 7 tests pass, and I verified extra edge cases beyond the suite (PERCENT:100, out-of-range/invalid coupon forms, per-line half-up rounding).
